title: A new way to support Pollinations
summary:
Ko-fi joined the ways to support Pollinations, with a homepage widget to make it easy to find.

The homepage gained a floating Ko-fi “Tip Us” widget, and GitHub’s funding links now include Ko-fi alongside GitHub Sponsors and Open Collective. The homepage news heading also now shows the newest entry without repeating it in the list.

highlights.title: Support via Ko-fi
highlights.text: The homepage has a new Ko-fi “Tip Us” widget. Supporters can also connect a Discord account for premium roles. [Visit Pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).
